observation.command:
cd /tmp
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ | sed -n 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
echo "=== ows root via qgis host (auth) ==="; curl -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" -w " HTTP:%{http_code}\n" | tail -c 200
echo "=== webdav propfind depth ==="; curl -sk --resolve files.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X PROPFIND -H "Depth: 1" https://files.localhost/ -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" | head -c 300
